name: Taste LGD #4
description:
The taste of a lover is oh so sweet.
Often time that taste can live in your heart for weeks,
Wouldn’t you love to box it up, and have it for keeps?
Something to bring you joy,
When your heart is feeling weak?
But that taste can be bitter if the day when love goes south,
The sour of anger,
Broken hearts,
Angst in your mouth.
